# Surviving the Feds

> Plain-English guides, free calculators, and books on the federal criminal system for defendants and their families, by Bilal Khan, an author who went through the federal system firsthand. Not a law firm. Nothing here is legal advice; always talk to a licensed attorney about a specific case.

Two books: *Surviving Pretrial* (arrest through sentencing, for defendants and families) and *The 2255 Motion Handbook* (challenging a federal conviction or sentence under 28 U.S.C. § 2255, written for non-lawyers). Both are sold on Amazon. The free articles and tools below are written to stand on their own.

## Start here
- [Just arrested or indicted? Start here](https://survivingthefeds.com/start-here.php): triage by situation, for the person charged and the family.
- [Is my federal lawyer any good?](https://survivingthefeds.com/is-my-lawyer-any-good.php): a 6-point checklist.
